questions.cardText:
[Anthropology] In anthropology, what is “participant observation”?
A. A research method
B. The incident when a participant actively observes a researcher’s action
C. The study of ancient artifacts
Answer: A. Participant observation is a method where an anthropologist actively engages and participates in the community being studied.
questions.en: What is the name of the anthropological research method in which the researcher actively takes part in the life of the community being studied?
questions.de: Wie heißt die ethnologische Forschungsmethode, bei der die forschende Person aktiv am Leben der untersuchten Gemeinschaft teilnimmt?

timeline.labelEn: Eduard C. Lindeman coins the term “participant observation”
timeline.labelDe: Eduard C. Lindeman prägt den Begriff „teilnehmende Beobachtung“

questions.cardText:
[Architecture] Which architectural style is the Sydney Opera House most associated with?
A. Gothic Revival
B. Baroque
C. Modern Expressionist
Answer: C. The Sydney Opera House, designed by Danish architect Jørn Utzon, was inspired by the form of seashells and was initially thought to be unbuildable.
questions.en: With which architectural style is Jørn Utzon's shell-roofed Sydney Opera House most associated?
questions.de: Mit welchem Architekturstil wird Jørn Utzons Opernhaus von Sydney mit seinen Schalendächern vor allem verbunden?

timeline.labelEn: Queen Elizabeth II formally opens the Sydney Opera House
timeline.labelDe: Königin Elisabeth II. eröffnet offiziell das Opernhaus von Sydney

questions.notes: Wikipedia: 'a modern expressionist design'; accept 'Expressionist architecture' / 'Modern Expressionism'.
